code.r:
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

flights = read_csv("data/flights.csv") %>%
  select(dep_delay) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay))

set.seed(5460)
stats = replicate(n = 1000, expr = {
  flights %>%
    slice_sample(n = 25, replace = FALSE) %>%
    summarize(stat = mean(dep_delay)) %>%
    pull(stat)
})

tibble(stat = stats) %>%
  summarize(samples = n(), center = mean(stat),
            se_observed = sd(stat),
            se_formula = sd(flights$dep_delay) / sqrt(25))
code.sql:
-- one sample of 25 flights without replacement
SELECT AVG(dep_delay) AS stat
FROM (
  SELECT dep_delay FROM flights
  WHERE dep_delay IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY random()
  LIMIT 25
);
-- PostgreSQL shortcut: FROM flights TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (1)
-- repeat 1000 times, then take sd() of the 1000 stats

SELECT dep_delay  -- no MEDIAN() in SQLite: take the middle row in R
FROM (
  SELECT dep_delay FROM flights
  WHERE dep_delay IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY random()
  LIMIT 25
);
